title: 5-toubun no Hanayome∽
content:
Another tragic showing of how rushed and roughed up the finale was.

These two episodes are better watched before the movie, even though they came out after it, their events happen before the movie’s and even lead up to it.

For a harem show, they really carried without your run in the mill swimsuit extra. Not only a beach episode but also a pool one, plus some heartfelt moments to close it off. This one is one to remember. No only that, but studio Shaft blessed us with an original opening and ending theme songs with some of the best OP visuals in recent memory, the likes of which put  some shows cough OPM cough to shame.

These couple of episodes really embody what the two seasons were, full of sass, full of spice, full of teasing, it did not forget what made the show special, unlike the movie was at times. I could have been a perfect open ended conclusion to the story in my opinion without having to settle with the mediocracy of the movie’s finale.

Overall: 7.76/10.
